+from collections import deque
+
+def transform(grid):
+    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
+    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
+    seen = set()
+    q = deque()
+    for r, c in ((0, 0), (0, w - 1), (h - 1, 0), (h - 1, w - 1)):
+        if grid[r][c] == bg and (r, c) not in seen:
+            seen.add((r, c)); q.append((r, c))
+    while q:
+        r, c = q.popleft()
+        for dr, dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
+            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
+            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:
+                seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
+    # Recolor only the smallest enclosed region (the pocket indicated by the walls).
+    unseen = {(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == bg and (r,c) not in seen}
+    comps = []
+    while unseen:
+        start = unseen.pop(); comp = {start}; q = deque([start])
+        while q:
+            r,c=q.popleft()
+            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
+                p=(r+dr,c+dc)
+                if p in unseen:
+                    unseen.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
+        comps.append(comp)
+    if not comps: return [row[:] for row in grid]
+    target = min(comps, key=len)
+    return [[4 if (r,c) in target else grid[r][c] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
*** End Patch
